title: Chapter 932
paragraphs: Chapter 932
231. Determination (5)
"I won't kill any more powerless people if you tell the truth."
Jin did not believe Paerleto's words.
"The truth...."
Jin aimed his sword at Paerleto, taking deep breaths. His strength had almost completely drained, and his sword seemed to tremble with the slightest loss of focus.
"Alright. But before I answer, I have one question."
Swish-

Paerleto launched another sword energy towards the outer battlefield. Just like the forest where Dante had been hiding was obliterated earlier, the sword energy was bound to massacre innocent people who had barely managed to hide.
"I'm the only one asking questions. Because of your nonsense just now, another thousand 'bugs' have died."
The tears that had streaked Jin's cheeks were drying. Blood, sweat, ash, and tears mixed, leaving a deep stain. It was a pain that could never be forgotten, a pain that should never be forgotten.
It's heavy.
The fatigue of his body was heavy, and the guilt of not being able to prevent the death of people was suffocating him. Jin was not staring at Paerleto in front of him, but at the weight itself.

"I'm losing to you right now, Paerleto. So, whatever you do, I can't stop it. Conversely, you can't stop my mouth either. Unless you kill me or cut out my tongue. But you can't do that... because it would be futile."
Obsession with Sakiel was what kept Jin from getting cut.
Paerleto could not deny it. He had not yet accepted Sakiel's death. He had to hear something from Jin, a story that would satisfy him. He wanted to hear it.

"We've both received scars we can't wash off. You lost Sakiel, and I failed to protect the people I should have protected. Maybe, as you said, even my friends could be dead. No matter how this fight ends now, we can't live like before. What awaits you and me is not the joy of victory, but eternal pain that we can't forget, even in death."
The pain that each could experience had already exceeded its limits. There certainly was a limit to the sadness a human could feel.

So from now on, it didn't matter who lost more, who suffered more. Paerleto had lost the most important meaning of life when he lost Sakiel, and Jin would despair the same way now even if all the remaining people died.
"So, there's no need to react so sensitively just because I ask a few questions. Just as Sakiel won't come back even if you kill me, the people who died won't come back even if I kill you."
Gulp...!
Paerleto spat out the dark blood that had risen to his mouth. The violet aura enveloping him was also gradually turning darker. The devil in him was continuously being drawn out by the Heart Demon.

In fact, Paerleto knew better than anyone. That he could not go back, that even if he heard more from Jin about Sakiel's death, the outcome was determined. He would eventually be consumed by the Heart Demon, amplified by the emptiness of his revenge and the persistent feeling of loss.
Jin also saw his future clearly.
Therefore, Jin was not afraid of the future. Even if he died, someone would slay Paerleto, who was being eroded by the devil.

"Even if Jin dies, there are still Shiron and Luna in Runkandel, there are brothers and knights, and there are comrades in Tikan. Surely, one of them will carry on his legacy. Just as Jin has been carrying on the will of Runkandel a thousand years ago.
But behind Paelleto, there is only a monster from the abyss that seeks only terrible pain. It will be filled only with the unfortunate beings brainwashed by the monster.
"Billions who have forgotten what they were."
"What are you suddenly talking about?"
"You are one of them, Paelleto. Even when you reach the star, you don't know who you are. You don't know what you are fighting for."
"What I want is clear, Jin Runkandel."
"Setting up pain as a new order and Sakiel's revenge? The latter may be true. But the former, is it really your will? That is not you, but Jito's will."
"Lord Jito's will is the will of the demon world."
"Unlike you, I met demons who escaped brainwashing, even though they were definitely weaker than you."
"As expected, Bisept is sticking with you."

"They had beliefs. The belief in protecting their families from Jito's demons, protecting their comrades, protecting their lives. And you once led them. You, who were the leader of the resistance, have become Jito's butcher knife."

"It's a higher world that is hard to understand as lower beings like you. In a world where the order of pain has settled, it won't be chaotic like now. Everything will be in place and everyone will bear their rightful destiny."
"Do you think Sakiel would have thought that way?"

Clang! Paelleto struck his sword. Jin was momentarily swayed by the shock of blocking his sword. It was a sword that Paelleto hit with the intention of plunging into the ground, but somehow Jin did not fall and regained his balance.
Paelleto didn't know what was making Jin so solid. The time to endure things like readiness for death or will had long since passed.

"What if Sakiel didn't really want Jito's order, Paelleto. Don't talk nonsense about how I am insulting Sakiel and that can't be. Have you ever looked directly at Sakiel, yourself, and those who fought with you? Did you directly face your own people who were driven to the battlefield by a single command of Jito and suffered death?"
"I have always watched all of that accurately."

"No, all you have seen so far is just the truth blurred by brainwashing. You know Dialus Claupino well, right? He was crying when he was stabbed by my sword at the last moment. As if he had realized something belatedly. What about Sakiel? What do you think her mind was at the end?"
A silence flowed for a moment.

"I couldn't properly see Sakiel's end unlike Dialus, due to the scene of loss. However, our record mage is now checking the battlefield. It will soon be confirmed what Sakiel was like at the end. What she was thinking when she died, who she was cursing when she died. I think it's Jito for some reason."
What Jito wants is not just the pain of the world.
After starting the war with the demon world, Jin had been feeling that way for a while. The monster wants all the demons it controls to be buried in pain.
Otherwise, there would be no reason to use its minions as consumables, and no reason to conduct the war in this way.
If Paelleto had been sent to the mortal realm before the castle in Grosh collapsed, if more cracks had been released in various places in the mortal realm, if Jito himself had come out faster.

The mortal realm would never have been able to seize the opportunity. Jin thought that the moves Jito had placed on the battlefield were never the best for victory. They all just seemed to be good moves for everyone to fall into pain.

"I've also heard from the Viscepts that most of them have families or loved ones held hostage by Jito. But is it only the people of Viscept who are being held? If I were Jito, I would have used all of your families as well."
Puhuhu...! Paelito burst into laughter.

"You're good at leaping to conclusions. Alright, let's say you're correct. But even so, nothing changes. You killed Sakiel. You, a mere human, killed Sakiel Grosh, who is especially superior among the demons. This is why I cannot forgive a world without order."
"Again, you end up with that crazy fatalism. You've become the butcher's knife of Jito because you've stopped thinking, trapped in the yoke of hatred without breaking free from the brainwashing."
"I've heard enough from you. It's your turn to answer me, Jin Run Kandel. Why are you so distraught over the deaths of other humans, why do you feel such a great sense of responsibility... tell me."
Paelito began to muster his strength again.
He thought it was time to truly finish off Jin. It seemed okay to kill him and fall into the swamp of the devil's rest.
Paelito wished Jito wouldn't save him from the swamp this time.
Hwaaa...!
Slowly, the flames of rage started to engulf Jin again.
"This is the first time I'm saying something like this since the time I killed Kidad Hole during my apprenticeship... Paelito, the reason I feel a sense of responsibility towards people is simple."
I'm someone who has died once and returned by reversing time.
"...What?"
Paelito's eyes widened.
He had never heard of something like regression being possible. However, Paelito could tell that Jin was telling the truth right now.

"24 years ago from now, I had met my death in the Akin Kingdom. The me from then was a very different person from now. I didn't have as many responsibilities like I do now. I was living for my own personal success. Thanks to being chosen by Soldierlet at the end."
Jin locked eyes with Paelito.

"I died in my past life in the year 1808. And it's now the year 1804... The 1804 I remember from then and now are completely different worlds. Back then, Glic, Hyung Shin, and Jito hadn't even made their appearances."
"How can that be...!"
Paelito couldn't even doubt it. He felt as though a great light that he had never seen from any immortal was emanating from Jin right now. He couldn't dismiss Jin's story as a lie.

"I also don't know why I regressed. Why it was possible, why it had to be me, why so many lives were decided because of me. If I hadn't regressed, perhaps more people would have been enjoying life than now. I remember the world being less chaotic then, that's all I can think of."
Paelito's heart was pounding wildly.

"But Paelito, if it is as you insist, that theory of fate. My regression is superior to any fate. If I hadn't regressed, neither you, Sakiel, Jito, nor anyone in the Demon World would have set foot on the land of Inse."
Paelito bulged his eyes and charged at Jin.
Again, he swung his Bascale with the intent to kill Jin, but Jin, with his eyes bulging, parried his sword.
"I will definitely transcend this fate. So you too overcome the brainwashing, and remember your original destiny, Paelito Belkasium."
